account_activation_code.subject: Your Frappé code: {Code}
account_activation_code.preheader: Enter it to activate your account. It expires in 15 minutes.
account_activation_code.heading: Activate your account
account_activation_code.intro: Hi {Name}. Enter this code on the screen where you signed up.
account_activation_code.footer: If you did not create a Frappé account, ignore this email: nobody can use it without the code.

password_reset_code.subject: Your code to change your password: {Code}
password_reset_code.preheader: Use it to choose a new password. It expires in 15 minutes.
password_reset_code.heading: Change your password
password_reset_code.intro: Use this code to choose a new password. Changing it signs you out everywhere.
password_reset_code.footer: Did you not ask for this? Your password stays the same and you can ignore this email.

email_change_code.subject: Your code to confirm your new email: {Code}
email_change_code.preheader: Confirm it to start using it. It expires in 15 minutes.
email_change_code.heading: Confirm your new email
email_change_code.intro: Until you confirm it, you keep signing in with your previous email.
email_change_code.footer: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this email and nothing happens.

registration_attempted.subject: Someone tried to create a Frappé account with your email
registration_attempted.preheader: If it was you, log in or reset your password.
registration_attempted.heading: Someone used your email to sign up
registration_attempted.intro: Someone tried to create a Frappé account with your email, but you already have one. If it was you, log in or reset your password.
registration_attempted.footer: If it was not you, ignore this email: your account and your password stay the same.

email_change_requested.subject: A change of your Frappé email was requested
email_change_requested.preheader: If it was not you, change your password now.
email_change_requested.heading: Your account email may change
email_change_requested.intro: Hi {Name}. A change of your account email to {NewEmailMasked} was requested. Until it is confirmed, you keep signing in with this email.
email_change_requested.footer: If it was not you, change your password now: it closes every other session.

email_changed.subject: Your Frappé email was changed
email_changed.preheader: If it was not you, undo it within 7 days.
email_changed.heading: Your account email changed
email_changed.intro: Hi {Name}. The email of your account was changed and this address no longer signs in. If it was not you, undo the change: the button works once and expires in 7 days.
email_changed.footer: If it was you, ignore this email. If it was not, undo it and then change your password.
